description: Java entity class representing a language within the sales management system. It contains fields for language code, sort order, and relationships to merchant stores. This class is mapped to the LANGUAGE table in the schema and incorporates auditing features.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Represents a language entity with fields for code, sort order, and relationships to merchant stores. It extends the generic SalesManagerEntity and implements auditing capabilities.
